name: brickforge
description: A LEGO® collection manager for your desktop: track sets and minifigures, see what they are worth on BrickLink, identify them from photos, and write eBay listings.

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "VITE,ELECTRON" -c "cyan,yellow" "npm run dev:vite" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development node scripts/launch-electron.js
scripts.demo: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n "VITE,ELECTRON" -c "cyan,yellow" "npm run dev:vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development node scripts/launch-electron.js --demo"
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.screenshots: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.screenshots.config.ts
scripts.package:win: npm run build && node scripts/prep-codesign-cache.js && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.js
